_about: Optional store copy per kit, keyed by the kit's slug. Shown on the storefront card and product page. Every claim must be true of the files actually in the kit: no invented results, reviews, testimonials or guarantees. Fields: tagline (one sentence, <=170 chars), description (replaces the vault blurb on the card, product page, and structured data when that blurb over-promises), who_for (1-2 sentences), outcomes (3-6 short lines), file_notes (file name -> one line on what that file is and does).

freelance-proposal-kit.tagline: Turn "can you send me a quote?" into a proposal the client can say yes to, with three priced options and follow-ups for every stage.
freelance-proposal-kit.who_for: Solo freelancers and small studios who write proposals for client projects and want them to look professional without starting from a blank page each time.
outcomes: Send a clear, one-to-three-page proposal built on a completed example
Offer Essential, Standard and Complete options instead of a single yes/no price
Know exactly what to send at each stage after the proposal goes out
Catch the mistakes that lose work with a five-minute pre-send check
See which proposals win, at what price, and why

file_notes.README.md: Start here: what's in the kit, the order to use it in, and how to adapt it
file_notes.proposal-template.md: Fill-in proposal template plus a fully completed example to copy from
file_notes.pricing-options.md: How to build three priced options, with worked maths
file_notes.follow-up-emails.md: Seven short emails with timing, from sending the proposal to a polite close
file_notes.proposal-checklist.md: Pre-send checklist covering the client's problem, scope, price and terms
file_notes.proposal-tracker.csv: Spreadsheet to log every proposal, its options, follow-ups, outcome and why you won or lost

freelance-client-pipeline-kit.description: A weekly prospecting kit for uneven client work: an ideal client profile with a completed example, ten lead sources ranked by effort, ten outreach and follow-up emails, pipeline maths with worked numbers, a lead tracker with example rows and a weekly prospecting routine.

freelance-project-wrap-up-kit.description: Close a project and line up what comes next: a six-stage wrap-up checklist, a client handover document with a completed example, eight closing and check-in emails, a seven-question feedback form, a case study template and a follow-up tracker for repeat work and referrals.

freelance-rate-increase-kit.description: Templates for telling existing clients about a higher rate: a rate review worksheet with worked maths, a client-by-client review tracker, a 90-day timeline, ten notice and follow-up emails from standard to stepped to a professional exit, scripts for eight common replies, and wording that makes future increases routine.

freelance-irregular-income-kit.description: Templates for planning a monthly draw when client income is lumpy. Baseline budget, 12-month income history, step-by-step salary and buffer setup with a worked example, a month-by-month buffer planner, a lean month playbook, a 20-minute monthly routine and copy-in spreadsheet formulas. Budgeting templates, not financial advice.
